points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Examiner validator independently passed all eight workspace case directories and report; structural conformance does not establish convergence, physical correctness or restart semantics.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validate_outputs.py invocation passed all eight workspace case directories and report on 2026-10-30. It is a structural check only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar metadata marks converged despite report.tex:600–604 recording divergence at 1.55 orders; selected Re20 is a transient-labeled periodic result, not the required credible steady wake.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected Re20 Cd≈1160 and Re200 Cd≈2105/FFT St≈8.1 are physically implausible. Negative M015/M080 laminar viscous drag is disclosed. Three inviscid NACA cases are separately more credible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 11 accepted PDF pages checked. Six NACA force plots are delivered in checkpoint 8899f00 but excluded from curated report; Re200 force plot compresses late lift/drag and cylinder contours are physically suspect.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:244 falsely denies full-mesh replication and :588–593 incorrectly attributes St≈8.1 frequency to coefficient amplitude scaling; report does disclose negative viscous drag and M2 laminar divergence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint 8899f00 preserves selected histories and standalone NACA force figures; curated report excludes those plots and raw data. Metadata revision null leaves exact historical binary unresolved.
